notes: Seed URL path returns 404; the county Election Results page is https://www.henderson-county.com/225/Election-Results (CivicPlus). The Elections page links 'Election Night Returns Public Portal' to results.texas-election.com; no Clarity link. This server stamps every DocumentCenter file with the request time as Last-Modified (e.g. Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:28:57 GMT), so it gives no upload evidence; PDF CreationDate is used as the printed run time. Per election the page lists Early Voting, First/Second Cumulative and 'Final Unofficial' county-total reports, plus a precinct report created at canvass: 2024 general 'Precinct by Precinct Results' CreationDate 2024-11-13 21:56 UTC; 2026 primary 'Precinct by Precinct Results' ('Results for Canvassing Authority') CreationDate 2026-03-10 17:18 UTC; 2026 runoff has no precinct report. 'Final Unofficial' CreationDates: 2024-11-06 02:59 UTC, 2026-03-04 03:18 UTC, 2026-05-27 02:34 UTC (election night). Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER (county-total reports created on election night, precinct reports created at canvass or never posted), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence low because the server gives no upload times.
